changes: Implemented Lattice Parallel Wave planning in packages/main/src/core/lattice-parallel-wave.ts with storyRefs, hostCandidates, mergeOrder, visible degradations, and fail-closed authority metadata; added CLI handlers in packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-parallel-wave.ts; registered parallel_wave_create, parallel_wave_inspect, and parallel_plan in registry, MAIN_TOOLS, command policy, process fact levels, and DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS; documented the non-authority Lattice boundary in docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md; added focused smoke coverage in packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-parallel-wave-smoke.ts; recorded TEST acceptance evidence in .koala/story/actives/B-29b6/evidence/transcript-diff.md.
usage: Build packages/main, then run node packages/main/dist/cli.js --root . parallel_wave_create --storyIds=["B-xxxx"] --hosts=["codex"] --format=json --output /tmp/wave.json; inspect with parallel_wave_inspect --file=/tmp/wave.json --format=json; plan with parallel_plan --file=/tmp/wave.json --format=json. These commands are read-only L0 planning projections and must not be treated as production authority receipts.
expectedOutcome: User can create, inspect, and plan a Lattice Parallel Wave from active or selected stories; outputs should include parseable wave/inspect/plan schemas, candidate/blocking/degradation guidance, and must preserve productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, receiptRefs=[].
actualTranscript: User-value TEST transcript ran node packages/main/dist/cli.js --root . parallel_wave_create, parallel_wave_inspect, and parallel_plan for B-29b6. Observed schemas were koala.parallel_wave.v1, koala.parallel_wave_inspect.v1, and koala.parallel_plan.v1; storyCount=1; parallelDevCandidates=[B-29b6]; planOnlyStories=[]; blockedStories=[]; authority productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, receiptRefs=[].
outcomeDiff: No user-value mismatch found. Actual output matched expected schemas and preserved the non-authority boundary; conditional receipt verification remained a visible productionDone blocker.
limitations: Koala global binary in the shell did not know the new commands before this worktree build is installed, so user-value acceptance used node packages/main/dist/cli.js from the built worktree. koala validate still uses advisory fallback npm test because this repo has no validate.ts/js/mts or configured validate.command(s); focused build, smoke, command ownership, reviewer evidence, and transcript evidence cover the feature.
pitfalls: Two REVIEW findings were valid and fixed: DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS initially omitted the three new commands, so active-story phase gating would reject them; IDEA was initially counted as an active scheduling peer. TEST transcript evidence also had to be explicitly added to the enforce-mode scope contract by rolling back to DEV because TEST cannot mutate scope contracts.
